Trump's day in 5 quotes (Tuesday, October 27) 🇺🇸
Love it or hate it? Tell us which one got you 👇

1. “We're thinking about renaming it the Trump Strait.” (said before)
   📍 Rally · Corpus Christi, Texas
2. “It will become a prosperous country, and who knows? Maybe someday soon, it will become a prosperous 51st state.”
   📍 Rally · Corpus Christi, Texas
3. “I ended eight wars even though I didn't get the Nobel Prize.”
   📍 Rally · Corpus Christi, Texas
4. “Nobody knows her last name, by the way.”
   📍 Rally · Corpus Christi, Texas
5. “He told me, you know how you find oil in Venezuela? You look on the ground.”
   📍 Rally · Corpus Christi, Texas

Trump's day in 5 quotes (Wednesday, October 28) 🇺🇸
Love it or hate it? Tell us which one got you 👇

1. “If Republicans win the House of Representatives and the Senate, I am going to give all adult citizens in the United States $5,000.” (said before)
   📍 Rally · Chillicothe, Ohio
2. “Isn't it nice to have a president who doesn't need a teleprompter?”
   📍 Rally · Chillicothe, Ohio
3. “I passed it all three times. I aced it. Zero mistakes all three times.” (said before)
   📍 Rally · Chillicothe, Ohio
4. “Oh, Canada has been ripping us off for many, many years.”
   📍 Rally · Chillicothe, Ohio
5. “You know, I owned the Miss Universe contest long ago.”
   📍 Rally · Chillicothe, Ohio

2. “I always wait for people to start leaving, but they never leave.” (said before)
   📍 Rally · Rock Hill, South Carolina
3. “Paid protester. They pop up every once in a while. Don't worry about it.”

4. “They don't know what the hell they're doing, economists.”
   📍 Rally · Rock Hill, South Carolina
5. “They are fake news, you're fake news, do you understand that?”
   📍 Rally · Rock Hill, South Carolina

Trump's day in 5 quotes (Friday, October 30) 🇺🇸
Love it or hate it? Tell us which one got you 👇

1. “I thought this was gonna be my last one, Byron. I thought this was it. I thought I could relax. 28 days in a row of this crap is a lot.”
   📍 Rally · Daytona Beach, Florida
2. “Fox is giving Democrats more time than they give Republicans.”
   📍 Rally · Daytona Beach, Florida
3. “David Jolly, a real loser. But a terrible person. Everybody hated the guy.”
   📍 Rally · Daytona Beach, Florida
4. “I had like close to 50,000. He had 900. They don't want to mention my crowd size.”
   📍 Rally · Daytona Beach, Florida
5. “Go and check your 401(k)s. Your 401(k)s are up 69%, 72%, 57%, 79%.”
   📍 Rally · Daytona Beach, Florida
